newsitem.title: PERU: Policemen at Peru hostage site get food poisoning.
newsitem.headline: Policemen at Peru hostage site get food poisoning.

text.p: While the 72 hostages inside the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima get healthy, low-fat meals delivered daily by the Red Cross, the policemen outside may not be eating quite so well.
Four officers stationed outside the besieged house suffered food poisoning on Monday after eating a popular marinated fish dish, local radio reports said.
One was sent to a hospital and three were treated by paramedics on the scene for symptoms of food poisoning after eating cebiche, a Peruvian dish made of raw fish marinated in lemon juice and onions.
The officers were among dozens stationed around the house in the exclusive San Isidro district of Lima, where Marxist guerrillas have been holding hostages for more than three months.
